aipw_interval_method: Normal Wald interval using the empirical variance of the AIPW pseudo-outcome within each replicate.
monte_carlo_uncertainty: Bonferroni familywise 95% intervals across the fixed nine scenario-by-confounding cells; Student-t intervals for mean bias and exact Clopper-Pearson intervals for interval coverage proportions.
interpretation: Exploratory synthetic mechanism study. The intervals quantify Monte Carlo uncertainty within this specified generator only; they do not establish real-world identification, proxy validity, or approval.
prohibited_changes: Do not combine this replicated study with the single-run illustrative bootstrap report.
Do not interpret AIPW as removing unmeasured confounding.
Do not claim real-world identification or proxy approval from simulation coverage.
